results.evidence_text: We investigated the associations of plasma omega-3 and omega-6 PUFAs with the incidence of overall and 19 site-specific cancers in a large prospective cohort.
results.one_sentence_explanation: Claude+Gemini's INCLUDE is supported because this original UK Biobank cohort evaluated plasma omega-6 PUFAs against incidence of 19 site-specific cancers including prostate cancer, so the target relationship is separable even though its numeric estimate is not reported in the abstract.
